Container.Name: Reelarr
Container.Overview: An *arr for live recordings. Reelarr identifies, tags and files live concert recordings — tapes, soundboards, Live Music Archive downloads — into a clean library. Anything it isn't sure about waits in a review queue. Starts in dry run; nothing is deleted; every change can be undone. After installing, open the web UI: a setup wizard creates your login and picks your folders.

Config.Name: Shares
Config.Description: Mounted at the same path inside, so the setup wizard shows the paths you know and they match your other containers. Narrow it (e.g. /mnt/user/data) if you prefer.

Config.Name: REELARR_MEDIA_PATH
Config.Description: Where the Shares path appears inside the container. Keep equal to the Shares container path.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the files Reelarr writes (unRAID: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group for the files Reelarr writes (unRAID: users = 100).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 000 keeps everything editable over SMB, like the rest of unRAID.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for logs. The schedule's zone is chosen in the setup wizard.
